name: Scpi
description: Generic SCPI instrument driver — works with any SCPI-compliant device (oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, power supplies, spectrum analyzers) over TCP/IP (LXI, raw socket port 5025), Serial (RS-232/USB-to-serial), or USBTMC (direct USB-B). Provides raw query/write access, configurable timeouts, init command sequences, and auto-connect with *IDN? identity query.
changelog:
## 1.3.1

### Bug Fixes

- Coalescing pump now captures the latest pending value **inside** the
  transport lock, after `EnforceCommandIntervalAsync`. The previous
  version sampled it at dequeue time, so writes that arrived during the
  interval wait spawned a fresh pump iteration each — turning
  `commandIntervalMs: 1000` into a slow staircase instead of a single
  jump.

### Internal

- Bump every patch release so `Version` makes it easy to tell whether a
  running driver matches the source tree.
